evidence_quote: vacuum_buffer_usage_limit ( integer ) Specifies the size of the Buffer Access Strategy used by the VACUUM and ANALYZE commands. A setting of 0 will allow the operation to use any number of shared_buffers . Otherwise valid sizes range from 128 kB to 16 GB . If the specified size would exceed 1/8 the size of shared_buffers , the size is silently capped to that value. The default value is 256 kB .
